meta.name: skill-creator-pro
meta.description: Create and evolve production-ready skills with reusable scripts, references, and validation. Use for new skill creation, skill upgrades, and enforcing consistent metadata and structure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和升级生产级技能，确保元数据与结构一致
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要创建或维护多个技能，并保证它们结构规范
copy.tagline_en: Create and upgrade production-ready skills with consistent metadata and structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or maintain multiple skills with consistent structure

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你创建或升级技能包，确保描述准确、元数据一致，并生成可复用的脚本和模板。
howto.when: 当你要求创建新技能、升级现有技能，或需要统一技能包的元数据与结构时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新的技能包，用于文件分类。
say.note: Claude 会引导你明确意图并生成技能包。

say.text: 升级我的现有技能包，确保描述符合触发条件。
say.note: Claude 会检查并更新元数据和结构。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you create or upgrade skill packs, ensuring accurate descriptions, consistent metadata, and generating reusable scripts and templates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a new skill, upgrade an existing one, or enforce consistent metadata and structure across skill packs.

say_en.text: Create a new skill pack for file classification.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to clarify intent and generate the pack.

say_en.text: Upgrade my existing skill pack to ensure descriptions meet trigger conditions.
say_en.note: Claude will check and update metadata and structure.
